subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: The system shall keep a plan's handoff free of parts that only a feature can supply, so that a non-feature intake can produce the same handoff.
rationale: Later lanes converge on the plan (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-8)
fit_criterion: A hand-built non-feature fixture — intent cited from an existing requirement, one decision, one plan — yields a handoff the same projection accepts, with no feature-only field left empty or faked.
